queries: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS s FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), sh AS (SELECT link_to_member, s, s * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(s) FROM g) AS share FROM g), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM sh) SELECT SUM(sh.s) AS total_amount, AVG(sh.share) AS avg_share, AVG(sh.share - av.a) AS avg_share_minus_avg FROM sh, av WHERE sh.share > av.a

assumptions.assumption: Missing link_to_member means NULL only; empty strings are treated as real member values.

The average share is the plain average across all groups, so it equals 1/number of groups. The final two metrics are computed only over the kept groups, since the request says to return them for those groups.
